pages.title: Day 2: Metalhead
pages.text: Metalhead is Day 2 of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995), an unusual stage seen from above that is just a boss fight. Vectorman has a special form for it.

pages.title: Three days from above
pages.text: Only three days of Vectorman are seen from above, Days 2, 7 and 11, says Sega Retro. Electronic Gaming Monthly wrote in 1995 that these levels "aren't very long but they do break up the monotony of the game".
